The Canucks have a unique opportunity to encourage care for the places that make this region special. That can mean supporting local environmental initiatives, reducing the organization’s footprint, and helping fans see sustainability as something the whole community can contribute to.

Being mindful of our environments isn’t a one-time project. It’s a habit built through many small decisions, made consistently. When the Canucks take care of their team culture, their arena, and the community around them, they help create conditions in which everyone can thrive.
